specs.prompt: Create one horizontal triptych for the original fantasy card-tactics game Sigils & Oaths. Exactly three equal square panels in one 3:1 image, no gaps or borders, no text, letters, numerals, UI or watermarks. Each panel is an independent evocative illustration; primary action centered in the middle third vertically, for a wide card-strip crop. Refined painterly gouache and oil fantasy illustration, antique gold, jade teal, deep indigo shadows, warm light, bold readable silhouettes and controlled details. Match the reference brushwork and world; no existing franchise characters. Left: a blizzard sweeping a pine valley and frozen stone watchtower, icy turquoise and white snow, dramatic frosty gusts. Middle: gold sunlight breaking through receding violet storm clouds over a green valley, a clear opening of serene blue sky, hopeful calm. Right: one single luminous blue crystal held in a bronze-gauntleted hand above a strategy map, swirls of teal magical energy, dark background.
